designationHistory.indexText: The Migratory Bird Conservation Commission established Currituck National Wildlife Refuge.

authority.citation: Migratory Bird Conservation Act of 1929; Migratory Bird Conservation Commission approval

designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Currituck National Wildlife Refuge, About Us

USFWS, 508 Currituck National Wildlife Refuge Comprehensive Conservation Plan (ServCat 168356): "The refuge was established on August 2, 1983, by the Migratory Bird Conservation Commission through the authority of the Migratory Bird Conservation Act of 1929"

review.note: Draft sentence was about Currituck County (1670). Refuge: Aug. 2, 1983 (CCP).

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Algonkians called the area “Coratank” which means “The Land of the Wild Goose.” The governor of colonial North Carolina established Currituck County in 1670 from part of Albemarle County.

historySource: Refuge About Us pages, fws.gov (draft, pending review)
